tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sāts+tsha 'debs pa'i cho ga dge tshogs rgya mtsho 'phel ba'i zla ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gang phyir gus pa re yang lhur blangs pas// dpag yas bsod nams chu gter 'phel byed pa// yon tan bsam mi khyab bdag dkon mchog gsum// skyabs su bsten no byang chub bar du skyongs// ring nas bsags pa'i sdig pa sbyang phyir dang*// tshad du bcal dka'i tshogs rab rdzogs bya'i phyir// sāts+tsha'i rnal 'byor nyams su bstar ba'i tshul// mdo rgyud mkhas pa'i gzhung don gsal bar phye// nyes skyon gzhom pa'i g.yul ngor mi spro zhing*// phan pa'i snying gros lkog tu 'doms min yang*// tshul 'dir 'bad pas mngon mtho nges legs kyi// dpal kun lag rtser sbyin la 'di rmad byung*// de'ang gnas skabs gang yang rung bar phan yon gzhal du med pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs sam/ sāts+tsha bskrun pa la/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ mjug phan yon bstan pa'o// dang po ni sa gsar du blang dgos na/ gnas der gzhi bdag la gtor ma byin la sa bslangs/ oṃ badz+ra kha na kha na hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ rin chen sna bdun gyi sa gzhir bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ zhes brjod kyin brko ste sa blangs zin pa la mi dgos so// gnyis pa ni sa des 'jim pa brdzis te brdung ba na/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub sems bsgom/ de nas rang gang mos pa'i lhar gsal bas 'jim pa byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ zhes pas 'jim pa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i phung por gyur/ bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal po'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung*/ 'jim pa la thim pas 'jim pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin can du gyur par bsam zhing*/

lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung bkug pa mthe bos mnan pa gan rkyal du bzhag pa'i steng*/ g.yas pa'ang de bzhin du byas pa kha bub tu bzhag la/ oṃ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// na mo bha ga wa te bai ro tsa na pra bhā rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te sa myak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya 'di lta ste/ thā/ oṃ sūk+ṣ+me rdul phran rdul phran sūk+ṣ+me/ sa mnyam pa'i dam tshig ma me sa ma ye/ zhi ma shān+te dul ma dān+te/ a sa mnyam med rang bzhin ma mā ro be/ a dmigs pa med ma na lam+bhe/ ta sgrol ma ram+bhe/ snyan grags ldan ma/ ya sho wa ti/ gzi brjid chen po/ ma hā te dza/ rigs bral ma/ ni rā kū le/ mya ngan las 'das ma/ ni ra wa ṇe/ sarba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis byin gyis brlabs ma/ bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭhā na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā zhes rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal po'i gzungs 'di lan nyer gcig bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs/ 'jim pa bcad pa'i tshe/ na mas+sa man+ta kun nas sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bud+dhā nāṃ/ oṃ rdo rje'i che ru gzhi tshugs/ badz+ra ā mu ṣe swā hā/ zhes brjod pas chos kyi skur grub par bsam/ 'bi 'bi bya ba'i tshe/ oṃ rdo rje 'byung ba'i ched du gzhi tshugs/ badz+rod+bha wā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rgyas par bsam/ snum 'byug pa dang 'og tu sa dkar 'byug pa na/ oṃ a ra rdul med rdul bral ma/ dze bi ra dze swā hā/ zhes brjod cing byang chub kyi sems kun du bzang pos bsgos par bsam/ 'bi 'bi rgyar gzhug pa na/ oṃ dhar+m+ma dhā tu gar+bhe swā hā/ zhes brjod cing thabs dang shes rab zung du chud par bsam/

brdung ba'i tshe/ oṃ rdo rje tho ba badz+ra muṅga ra a koṭ+ṭa rdungs shig ya a koṭ+ṭa rdungs shig ya hūm̐ zhes dang*/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ wā dī chos kyi ring bsrel snying po ma/ ma hā shra ma ṇaḥzhes rten 'brel snying po brjod cing ye shes chen po'i ngo bor gyur par bsam/ de nas nang gzungs rigs lnga'i sa bon dang*/ rten 'brel snying po gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs rnams bris pa yod pa'am/ med na 'bru'i me tog oṃ sarba thams cad rig ma bi d+ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing nang du 'bul/ rgya nas 'don pa na/ oṃ chos kyi dga' ba ma dhar+m+ma ra te swā hā zhes brjod cing rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bsams te/ de yan gyis longs sku grub par bsam/ gdan la bzhugs su gsol ba na/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha legs par rab gnas rdo rjes/ badz+re swā hā/ zhes brjod cing sprul sku grub par bsam ste/ de ltar gzugs sku gnyis kyis sems can gyi don mdzad par bsams la/ gong gi sngags dang bcas pas sa dkar gsol/ de nas me tog thogs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ṇi sha de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi nor bu brgya phrag mar me ma/ ta dīp+te 'bar ba 'bar ba chos kyi ring bsrel snying po ma dz+wa la dz+wa la dhar+m+ma dhā tu gar+bhe swā hā/ zhes dang rten 'brel snying po brjod cing me tog 'thor ba ni rab gnas bsdus par 'gyur zhing*/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te// skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrugs pa yi// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba 'don par shog /ces pas dge ba bsngo ba ste/ de dag ni sāts+tsha'i cho ga rgyas par bya ba'i tshul lo// yang na 'jim pa swa bhā was sbyang ba nas/ rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal po'i sngags nyer gcig bzlas pa'i bar sngar bzhin byas la/

'debs pa'i tshe rten 'brel snying po kho na zlo zhing btab pas sāts+tsha sku gsum gyi ngo bor grub par bsams la/ rab tu gnas pa'i sngags rnams brjod de/ dge ba bsngo ba gong ltar bya ba ni 'bring du bya ba'i tshul lo// yang na 'jim pa'i gong bu la rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal po'i gzungs ci nus bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs te/ rten 'brel snying po zlo zhing btab la/ rab gnas kyang sngags de nyid kyis me tog 'bul ba dang dge ba bsngo ba ni bsdus par bya ba'i tshul lo// gshin don du rus bu la sogs pa las sāts+tsha 'debs pa'i cho ga ni kun rig gi rtsa rig 'don pa sogs gzhan du gsal bas 'dir ma bris so// de ltar cho ga rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang rung gis sāts+tsha rgyun khyer lta bur byed pa'i tshe/ yul mchog dman gyi ched du dmigs pa'i bsngo ba smon lam bya ba'am/ 'dod don gsol gdab dang 'brel bar nyams su bstar ba'i dbang du byed na/ sāts+tsha tshar lnga btab pa'i dang po'i dge ba bsngos pa'i rjes thogs de ma thag par/ 'di skad du/ sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchod pa'i sprin gyis gtibs// lung rtogs bstan pa dri med phyogs bcur rgyas// bshad dang sgrub pa lhur len 'dus pa'i tshogs// nor 'dzin dkyil 'khor yongs khyab rgyas par shog /ces brjod/ gnyis pa'i rjes su dngos brgyud dpal ldan bla ma gang byon pa'i// zab yangs thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang*// da ltar bzhugs rnams sku tshe ring 'tsho zhing*// phrin las 'gro don phyogs bral rgyas par shog /ces dang*/ gsum pa'i rjes su/ bdag kyang skye ba 'di dang yang srid rnams// dkon mchog skyabs bzung tshe dpal 'byor pa 'phel// tshogs zung rgya mtsho'i pha rol legs brgal te// yon tan rin chen gter la dbang 'byor shog /ces dang*/ bzhi pa'i rjes su/ skyed byed drin du che ba pha mas mtshon// mar gyur rigs drug sems can srid do cog

/sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'ching ba yongs grol nas// thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong mchog phyin par shog /ces dang*/ lnga pa'i rjes su/ dus byas ring po ma yin mi phyugs kyis// nyer mtshon srid pa bar do'i sems can rnams// 'khrul snang 'jigs skrag sdug bsngal kun bral bar// dkon mchog byin brlabs rdzogs 'tshang rgya bar shog /ces brjod/ 'dod gsol byed na shog ces pa'i tshab tu/ mdzod ces pa'i bskul tshig bsgyur bas grub bo// gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu spro ba'am sāts+tsha mang po dus gcig tu bsags la rab gnas 'bring po tsam byed na/ rang thun mtshams kyi lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha sogs kyis bgegs bskrad/ bsgrubs pa'i bum chu'am rten rnying pa la sku khrus gsol ba'i khrus chu yod pa'am/ med na yid kyis bsams la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ shrī ye hūm̐ gi bar gyis khrus gsol/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sāts+tsha'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i seng ge'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyi skur gyur/ de zhu ba las chos sku'i mchod rten mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i bum pa'i nang du dbus su seng ge shar du glang chen/ lhor rta/ nub tu rma bya/ byang du mkha' lding rnams kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan re re dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ shar du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa sngon po sa gnon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ lhor trāṃ las rin po che trāṃ gis mtshan pa las rin 'byung ser po mchog sbyin mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ nub tu hrīḥlas pad+ma hrīḥs mtshan pa las 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/

byang du aḥlas sna tshogs rdo rje aḥs mtshan pa las don grub ljang gu skyabs sbyin mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can thams cad kyang dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i mtha' skor du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur zhes dang*/ sku brnyan yod na/ stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las rdo rje oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs par bskyed do// de nas de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes mang du brjod pas bstim/ lha thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma āḥs mtshan pa/ thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ slar yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas shrī ye hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad sogs kyis bstod/ mig thur ram rdo rje/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas bzung nas spyan dbye ba'i tshul bya zhing*/

kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang*// gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas// nam mkha'i mthas gtugs gyur pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi sho dha ne swā hā/ ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa thob ste sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces brjod/ ting nge 'dzin gyis bskyed cing bstim pa'i lha de rnams 'od du zhu ba las/ rten so so'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ 'bru gtsang ma'i me tog ye dharmā'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ khyad par du yang rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā zhes dang*/ ye dharmā lan gsum brjod cing me tog gtor/ slar yang mchod bstod sngar bzhin bya/ phun sum tshogs pa'am/ che ba'i che mchog sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ci rigs pas brjod cing me tog gi char phab ste/ rten rnams skye bos mi 'gom pa'i phyogs su bzhugs su gsol lo// gsum pa ni/ spyir mchod rten zhes pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rten gsum spyi la 'jug mod/ 'dir mchod rten dang sku gzugs so sor smos te bzhengs pa'i phan yon gsal rgyal gyis zhus par/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod rten rnams dang ni// gzugs sku rnams la rdul phran ci song ba// de yi grangs snyed de byed mi rnams kyis// lha yul sa steng nges par rgyal srid 'thob// gzugs dang gzugs med khams kyi ting nge 'dzin// phun sum tshogs pa'i sa mchog kun myangs nas// tha mar skye dang rga la sogs pa yi// sdug bsngal med par sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob// ces sogs dang*/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs brnyan bzhag pa'i phan yon brjod par/ gzugs brnyan byed pa'i gang zag sbyin pa po la phan yon/ gzhal med khang chen por gnas pa sogs dang*/ phyug cing nor mang ba sogs dang*/ gzugs bzang zhing lta na sdug pa sogs dang*/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po 'khor bzang po rin po che sna bdun dang ldan pa sogs dang*/ lus dang bral ma thag bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten lhar skyes nas der lha'i gnas bcu longs spyod pa la sogs pa'i phan yon lnga gsungs/ 'phags pa rmad du byung ba las kyang*/ 'dzam bu'i gling nas brtsams te stong gsum 'jig rten khams kyi bar rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin du byas te/ rgyun du zhugs pa rnams dang*/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang*/ phyir mi 'ong ba rnams dang*/ dgra bcom pa rnams dang*/ rang sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun la phul ba bas/ gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i mchod rten 'jim pa las skyu ru ra'i 'bras bu tsam byas pa'i bsod nams ches che bar bsngags pa sogs gsung rab rnams las rgya cher 'byung zhing*/ gong gi rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal po'i gzungs bzlas te mchod rten byas pa'i phan yon ni/ gzungs de nyid las/ gzungs 'di 'jim pa'am bye ma'i gong bu la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas la mchod rten bya'o// mchod rten de la rdul phra rab kyi grangs ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi mchod rten byas par 'gyur ro// rdul phra rab kyi grangs ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi lha dang mi rnams kyi skye ba phun sum tshogs pa thob par 'gyur ro// gang dang gang du skyes pa na skye ba dran par 'gyur ro// myur du bla na med pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro zhes dang*/

de bzhin du rten 'brel snying po bzlas pa'am/ nang du bcug pa'i phan yon sogs mang du 'byung ba rnams shes par byas nas tshul 'di la shin tu 'bad par rigs so// smras pa/ thub gsung rig byed 'byin po'i bka' yis stsal// dgongs 'grel bde 'byung ral pa'i khrod du gnas// dam pa'i gzugs brnyan sgrub thabs mtho ris klung*// thos brtson skal ldan shing rtas 'di na drangs// tshegs chung phan yon che ba mang bsnyad kyang*// bde gshegs gzugs brnyan bskrun pa'i do zla su// yid 'phrog me tog grangs med bzhad pa'i dbus// u dum wā ra gnyis pa cang mchis sam// tshul 'di bsdebs pa'i g.yar dam yi ge dag /snying la bkod pa gang tshe sa skyong gi /gsung bskul snyan dngags lhang lhang 'jebs pa'i che// sug pa'i yal 'dab zlos bu'i gar gyis rtsen// dge tshogs stobs su rdzogs pa'i rus sbal gyis// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho la zhugs rnam pa kun// mkhyen pa'i kun bzod dkyil 'khor legs phyung nas// lus can bde bar ngal gso'i rten gyur cig /ces sāts+tsha 'debs pa'i cho ga dge tshogs rgya mtsho 'phel ba'i zla ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sgang 'gram sa 'dzin blo bzang byams pa zhes pa'i gsung mchid kyis bskul ngor/ dri ma med pa'i bka' dang*/ jo bo a ti sha la sogs pa 'phags bod kyi dran dbang mang po'i dgongs 'grel las ji ltar 'byung ba nyams su blang bde bar ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas dpal gdong zhes pa gsar tshes kyi bgrang gzhi'i mchu zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa/ sgra mkhan rgyal sar phebs pa'i nyin grub par bgyis pa sems can thams cad la phan par gyur cig/ // ༄༅// skra dang sen mo la sogs pa sreg pa'i cho ga bde legs nyi ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// mkhyen brtse'i bung ba gzhon nu'i 'phur lding gis// 'chi med pad+ma'i zil mngar yongs bsdus nas// ring 'tsho'i dga' ston 'gyed pa'i lhar btud de// skra sen sbyong tshul bde legs nyi ma bstan// 'dir gson po'i skra dang sen mo sogs sku gzugs la sogs pa bzo ba'i rgyur bsre bar 'dod na/

de dag bsreg cing shin tu zhib par btags dgos/ rtsing na gson gshin gang la'ang gnod par gsungs pas/ de'ang ji ltar brtsam pa'i sbyor bar/ sa gzhi 'thas pa'am sla nga'i nang du rdul tshon gyis pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar po'i lte bar raṃ dkar po bris pa'i mthar 'o ma can la sogs pa'i shing bu zlum por brtsegs pa'i nang du skra sen dang so la sogs pa gang yin pa me mched sla ba'i shing skam po dang bcas te bzhag rang gi mdun du bsreg rdzas til dang dūrba/ rdo rje dril bu/ bum pa gnyis kha rgyan sogs 'og tu mkho ba'i yo byad rnams sta gon bya'o// dngos gzhi la rgyas pa na tshe dpag med kyi bdag bskyed gzhung ltar bsgom/ bsdu na/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// zhes sogs skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas nas rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i skur gyur par bsams la dpal 'bar sogs kyis me sbar/ a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar raṃ dkar po las me 'bar ba'i dbus su/ me lha dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng dang g.yon ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ gsus khyim che ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ rdo rje gsor zhing hūm̐ zhes pas phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas gnyis su med par bstim/ bdag gam sbyin bdag che ge mo'i tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang tshe'i bar du gcod pa thams cad snying ga nas yi ge kaṃ nag po'i rnam pas 'byung*/ sna sgo nas phyir 'thon te til la thim zhes brjod/ de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas bsreg rdzas dag so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlabs/

de nyid me lha'i zhal du gsol bar mos nas/ til snod bcas lag pa g.yon pas bzung*/ g.yas pas blangs te mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ ag+na ye sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya swā hā zhes pas til brgya rtsa sogs ci rigs par phul mthar/ bdag gam sbyin bdag che ge mo'i tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang tshe'i bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes dang*/ de bzhin du/ oṃ ag+na ye badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā zhes pas dūr wa ci rigs par phul mthar spel tshig sngar bzhin brjod/ skra dang so sen rnams tshig pa na/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra re re'i sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shap+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar dharma ra ṇi rol mor bcas pas mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// zhes sogs kyis bstod/ me lha'i rgyal pos bdag gi sogs nas bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol zhes 'dod don zhus nas/ oṃ ag+ne gats+tsha zhes pas me lha ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo// de nas skra dang so sen gang yin tshig pa'i ro ma rnams ma lus par bsdus la rin po che la sogs pa'i snod gtsang mar blugs/ tshe dpag med kyi bdag bskyed rgyas pa gong du song na des 'thus/ ma song na 'dir bdag bskyed sngon du btang nas bum pa gnyis dkyus ltar bsgrubs nas/ skra dang so sen gyi thal ba'i phung po'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig dmar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa sogs nas 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan pa'i bar gyis tshe dpag med bskyed/ de la nyer spyod bshams pa yod na byin gyis brlabs/ med kyang oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri mi tā a yur+dz+nya na re re'i sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shap+da rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo sogs kyis bstod do// de nas rnam rgyal bum chu nas las bum du bsres pas bkru zhing*/

tshe dpag med kyi sku dang phyag gi bum pa las kyang 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bab par bsam zhing*/ tshe gzungs dang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags dang*/ oṃ rat+na tsit+ta bi bi sa ra hūm̐/ bdag gam sbyin bdag che ge mo'i tshe thog ma med pa nas sogs kyi spel tshig mthar shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes yod pa ci mang brjod pa'i rjes su/ dril gsil dang bcas te/ sbyin pa'i stobs kyi sogs tshigs bcad re'i mtshams su/ tshe gzungs sogs gong gi sngags gsum spel tshig dang bcas pa'i bden stobs brjod/ slar yang tshe dpag med la mchod bstod sngar bzhin dang*/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol zhes 'dod don gsol ba btab/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ mtheb srin gyi se gol dang oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can rnams// tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med sogs kyis bsngo ba dang bkra shis brjod do// de nas skra sen sogs kyi ro ma rnams shin tu zhib par btags pa'i thal ba rnams 'jim pa dang bsres nas 'jim pa byin brlab bya ba ni/ 'jim pa swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i phung por gyur/ bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal po'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung*/ 'jim pa la thim pas 'jim pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin can du gyur par bsam zhing*/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung bkug pa mthe bos mnan pa gan rkyal du bzhag pa'i steng*/

g.yas pa'ang de bzhin du byas pa kha bub tu bzhag la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bai ro tsa na pra bhā rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha de samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sūk+ṣ+me sūk+ṣ+me/ sa me sa ma ye/ shān+te dān+te/ sa mā ro pe/ a na lam+bhe/ ta ram+bhe/ ya sho wa ti ma hā te dze/ ni rā kū le/ ni rā wa ṇe/ sar+b+ba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭhā na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā zhes rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal po'i gzungs 'di nyer gcig bzlas nas byin gyis brlabs te mchod rten byas pas/ mchod rten de la rdul phra rab kyi grangs ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi mchod rten byas par 'gyur ba sogs phan yon dpag tu med pa 'byung bar bshad do// de nas rgyas pa la mos na 'jim pa bcad pa dang 'bi 'bi bya ba'i sngags sogs mkhas pa gong ma rnams kyi yi ge dang kho bos kyang sāts+tsha 'debs pa'i cho ga dge tshogs rgya mtsho 'phel ba'i zla ba zhes bya ba zhig bgyis yod pa de dag tu lta bar bya zhing*/ de ltar mi nus pas skabs 'dir tshe gzungs dang rnam par rgyal ma'i gzungs rnams ngag tu gdon gyin swats+tsha dang sku brnyan sogs gang mos ci nus su gdab/ nang du gzungs sngags 'jug rgyu yod na rab/ med na oṃ sarba bid+yā swā hā dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā dang*/ ye dharmā sogs zlos shing sāts+tsha'i nang du 'bru'i me tog gzhug rab gnas kyang rgyas bsdus gang rigs byas te mchod rten gyi nang ngam ri mthon po'i rtser ram chu klung chen po'i 'gram la sogs par bskyal te mgo mjug ma log par bzhugs su gsol/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung la spyan drang du gzhug na brgyang bskyur mi byed par re re bzhin du chu'i steng du bzhugs su gsol zhing*/ sems kyis rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin du bsam mo// gal te gshin po'i don du byed na phal cher gong dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par shi ba de'i skra sen sogs bzhag la/

bsreg rdzas ni sdig sgrib sbyong ba kho na'i phyir yin pas til 'ba' zhig oṃ ag+na ye sarba pā paṃ da ha na kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes pas ci rigs dbul/ bdag bskyed dang bum bskyed kun rig gam mi 'khrugs pa sogs bya/ rus bu dang thal ba'i phung po'i steng du mi 'khrugs pa bsgoms la/ sngags kaṃ ka ni bzlas pa'i mthar spel tshig tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i sogs btags la bkru ba'am/ yang na don gsal nas 'byung ba ltar/ rus bu sogs kyi steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du a dkar po bsam/ de las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun skya chil chil babs pas/ tshe 'das kyi sdig pa thams cad dag par bsam zhing*/ oṃ na mo bha ga sogs rtsa rig dang*/ oṃ badz+ra pra marda nā ya swā hā zhes pa'i mthar spel tshig btags pa dang bcas pas bkru/ gnyis ka ltar yang 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu zhes sogs pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi tshigs bcad dang*/ 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs dang*/ sa 'di dug gi pha yin te zhes sogs dug sbyong gi tshigs bcad rnams so so'i mtshams su kaṃ ka ni'am rtsa rig skabs gang bab dang*/ bden stobs brjod pa rnams kun rig ltar byas te bkru/ de nas gang la ser sna rnam chags pa zhes sogs brjod cing*/ der me tog 'thor ba sogs kyang phyag len la mdzad ces mkhan chen bud+dha'i mtshan can gyis gsungs pas nus na rgyas pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur ro// rjes mchod bstod bya ba/ 'dod don gsol gdab/ sgrub thabs kyi mjug sdud rnams rang rang gi skabs bab kyi khyad par bsgyur ba ma gtogs gzhan thams cad gong ma'i rigs bsgre shes par bya'o// smras pa/ rnam smin lus kyi cha shas dkon mchog gi /rten bzang bskrun pa'i bsod nams mngar po'i dri// sdug bsngal tshad pa dbrog phyir 'thul ba 'di// tshad ldan legs bshad sā la'i nags las 'phos// gyi nar gnas pa'i rgyu tshogs rin chen khams// sbyang bsgyur thabs kyi cho ga 'di bgyis pas// rang gzhan bar chad sgrib pa kun bral nas// mngon mtho nges legs bde la reg gyur cig

/ces pa skra dang sen mo la sogs pa sreg pa'i cho ga bde legs nyi ma zhes bya ba 'di ni/ don gnyer dge slong kun dga' chos 'phel gyi ngor/ kun mkhyen bu ston dang mkhas grub gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha'i bzhed pa mthun par nyams su blang bde bar ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༄// gzungs 'bul gyi lag len nyung gsal bzhugs so// ༄༅// gang gi gsang gsum rten la brten// yid can bsod nams mchog spel ba// mchod 'os de la phyag byas nas// gzungs 'bul lag len cung zad bri// de yang rten gang yang rung bar chos kyi sku'i ring bsrel gyi snying po can bskrun pa dag gis gzungs gzhug ji ltar 'bul ba'i tshul la/ mchod rten yin na srog shing tsan+dan nam shug pa la sogs pa dang por skyes pa'i shar phyogs gang yin shes na rab/ de ltar min yang mgo mjug ma nor bar gru bzhir byas pa/ yar rtse mchod rten gyi rnam pa can mchod rten gyi bre las yar cung zad lhag tsam dang*/ mar rtse bang rim bzhi rdzogs tsam sleb par rdo rje phyed pa'i rnam par byas la/ de la 'dri

(ba)(ma) 'jug bya ba'i gzungs shin tu rgyas pa ni da lta'i gzungs par na gsal ltar dang*/ de ltar mi chud pa rnams la srog shing rtse mchod rten gyi 'og tsam gyi mdun ngos su oṃ/ de'i 'og tu hūm̐/ g.yas ngos su trām̐/ rgyab ngos su hrīḥ g.yon ngos su āḥ bre'i thad kyi mdun ngos su oṃ/ bre mgul thad du āḥ bum pa'i stod tsam du hūm̐ rnams bri/ nus na de mtshams nas oṃ sarba bid+yā swā hā/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā rnams mdun nas brtsams te bskor ba gcig la sngags tshan re chud par bri/ rtsa bar su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs bris la dar ser po'i na bza' gsol te mchod rten gyi dbus drang por gzugs/ gzungs rnams ni da lta'i par yig ltar na grangs yig go rim ma nor bar 'bras phye'am bag phye gang yin gyis mthud la dri bzang gis byugs/ dril ba'i tshe rang lugs la gzungs rnams kyi yi ge nang du bstan la dbu nas mar dril te 'dod gsol mjug tu 'ong bar byas/ bzhugs pa'i go rim/ bla ma'i mtshan (ka)(kha)(ga)(nga)(ca)(cha) gzungs rnams sku gzugs kyi dbu nas mgrin pa yan dang mchod rten gyi chos 'khor nas bre yan la chud par 'jug rgyud sde gong (ja) ma'i gzungs rnams sku gzugs kyi thugs ka'i stod yan dang mchod rten gyi bum pa'i stod yan la chud pa dang*/ rgyud sde 'og (ja) ma gsum gyi gzungs rnams sku rked dang bum rked nas bang rim bar dang*/ gzungs (ta) chen sde lnga ni stod smad thams cad du khyab par 'jug mdo (tha) gzungs rnams ni sku'i skyil krung dang mchod rten gyi bang rim yan dang*/ khri'i nang du chos (da) skyong dang nor (na) lha'i gzungs rnams dang bkra (pa)(pha) shis smon lam gyi rigs rnams 'jug gal te rten che chung gi dbang gis gzungs dbri bsnan dgos pa byung na'ang de dag gis rigs bsgres la gong 'og ma 'khrugs par byed/

khyad par sku'i gtsug tor la gtsug tor gyi gzungs kyi rigs dang*/ mdzod spur mdzod spu nor bu'i gzungs dang*/ mgrin par dbyangs gsal ci mang dang bdud rtsi ril bu rnams 'jug pa byung na legs/ gdung tsha dang byin rlabs rten gyi rigs rnams sku'i dbu nas thugs ka yan dang mchod rten gyi chos 'khor nas bum rked yan la chud par byed/ bkra shis smon lam gyi 'og gi gdan khri'i nang du tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo mo 'khor 'og dang pho 'khor steng la 'ong bar leb mor bzhag pa'i shar mdun du bstan la bzhag tshogs bdag gi 'khor lo sogs kyang yod na der 'jug de dag gi khor yug kun du rin po che sna tshogs 'bru sna zas sna nor sna ci 'byor pa rnams ras kyi khug mar blugs nas bzhag gzungs dang 'khor lo rnams la na bza' ser pos gsol ba dang gtsang sbra shin tu che bar bya/ gzungs rnams la sbyong ba bgegs bskrad dang rab gnas mdor bsdus grub na shin tu legs/ gseb tshag rnams su shing bal sogs kyis brdzangs nas mi 'khrul bar shin tu 'thas par byed pa gal che'o// zhes gzungs 'bul gyi lag len nyung gsal 'di ni dpal ldan rgyal mtshan gyi ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis chos sde bsam 'grub pho brang du bris pa dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
